arguments.query:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX cto: <https://nfdi4culture.de/ontology/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?otherIconclass ?otherLabel
WHERE {
  # Find resources that have Iconclass 25FF411
  ?resource cto:CTO_0001030 ?iconclass25FF411 .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?iconclass25FF411)), "25ff411"))
  
  # Find other Iconclass codes on the same resources
  ?resource cto:CTO_0001030 ?otherIconclass .
  FILTER(?otherIconclass != ?iconclass25FF411)
  
  OPTIONAL { ?otherIconclass rdfs:label ?otherLabel }
}
ORDER BY STR(?otherIconclass)
LIMIT 50

content.text: Long John SPARQL and the Secret of Data Island 🏝️
Long John SPARQL had no compass, no crew, and no patience for opaque query interfaces. What he had was an ontology, a browser full of questions, and LODEON.
To find the data treasure, Long John must solve seven tasks with the Culture Knowledge Graph and record every clue as inspectable evidence.
At the harbour tavern, the first clue is sung rather than spoken: “Whisky for my Johnny–A-Dur”. The crew checks the RISM source in the Culture Knowledge Graph instead of trusting a sea shanty by ear.

content.text: Before entering the island archive, Long John needs a disguise. The graph points to costume objects, and LODEON turns the results into a remote embed gallery.

attrs.title: Task 4: The Disguise Chest
attrs.query:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX nfdicore: <https://nfdi.fiz-karlsruhe.de/ontology/>
PREFIX cto: <https://nfdi4culture.de/ontology/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?label ?kompakktId ?embedUrl
WHERE {
  <https://nfdi4culture.de/id/E6078> <http://schema.org/dataFeedElement> ?element .
  ?element schema:item ?item .
  ?item rdfs:label ?label . FILTER regex(?label, "Wams|Weste", "i")
  BIND(REPLACE(STR(?item), "^.*/", "") AS ?kompakktId)
  BIND(IRI(CONCAT("https://semantic-kompakkt.de/viewer/index.html?entity=", ?kompakktId, "&mode=open")) AS ?embedUrl)
}

content.text: From the lookout, the crew inspects visual evidence. A SPARQL query returns image resources, and the IIIF node opens them as a zoomable gallery.

attrs.title: Task 5: The Island Lookout
attrs.query:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX nfdicore: <https://nfdi.fiz-karlsruhe.de/ontology/>
PREFIX cto: <https://nfdi4culture.de/ontology/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?label ?hertzianaId ?imageInfoUrl
WHERE {
  <https://nfdi4culture.de/id/E6064> <http://schema.org/dataFeedElement> ?element .
  ?element schema:item ?item .
  ?item cto:CTO_0001026 <https://iconclass.org/25FF411> .
  ?item nfdicore:NFDI_0000207 <https://nfdi4culture.de/id/E4461> .
  OPTIONAL { ?item rdfs:label ?label }
  BIND(REPLACE(STR(?item), "^.*/", "") AS ?hertzianaId)
  BIND(IRI(CONCAT("https://fotothek.biblhertz.it/iiif/3/", ?hertzianaId, "/info.json")) AS ?imageInfoUrl)
}
LIMIT 10
